panels.title: Security alerts
panels.description: Server-wide firing security alerts. CrowdSec is observation-only: detections do not block traffic. Missing monitoring is not proof of safety.

panels.title: Edge rejected
panels.description: Nginx closed the HTTP connection with its internal status 444. Other edge responses are not automatically classified as blocked.

panels.title: Upstream attempts
panels.description: Nginx selected an upstream. This includes connection failures and does not prove application execution or exploit success. Cached responses may require no upstream attempt.

panels.title: CrowdSec detections
panels.description: Actual CrowdSec alerts by scenario in each chart interval. A detection can contain several contributing events; this is not a request or ban count.

targets.expr: sum by (scenario) (count_over_time({security="crowdsec"} | json scenario, sites, source_ip | sites=~`.*"(${site:regex})".*` | source_ip=~`${source:regex}.*` | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Detections by site
panels.description: Detection counts, not request counts. Sites come only from Nginx-selected sites in contributing events. Alerts with several sites count once under Multiple sites; missing evidence is Unknown. A site filter matches any site in the evidence.

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (site) (count_over_time({security="crowdsec"} | json site, sites, source_ip | sites=~`.*"(${site:regex})".*` | source_ip=~`${source:regex}.*` | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Detections by source
panels.description: Actual CrowdSec detection counts by source IP. One detection can contain many events; not every request from that IP is malicious. IP addresses identify connecting infrastructure, not a person. No external reputation sharing is enabled.

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (source_ip) (count_over_time({security="crowdsec"} | json sites, source_ip | sites=~`.*"(${site:regex})".*` | source_ip=~`${source:regex}.*` | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: CrowdSec alerts / latest 25
panels.description: Native CrowdSec alerts from maintained detection scenarios, newest first. Up to 25 distinct alerts from the newest 100 records. Event counts refer to contributing events, not all requests by that IP. Sites come only from those events. Detection does not establish compromise, and no blocking is enabled. Unknown means no site evidence, not a guessed hostname.

options.content:
{{#each (detectionRows data)}}
{{scenario}}{{events_count}} events
{{source_ip}}{{siteLabel}}
{{timeLabel}}Inspect detection →
{{/each}}
options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .activity-list { width: 100%; padding: 0 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .activity-entry { display: block; padding: 12px 10px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-left: 3px solid transparent; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .activity-entry:hover, .activity-entry:focus-visible { background: rgba(127,127,127,.12); } .activity-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5794f2; outline-offset: -2px; } .activity-priority { border-left-color: #ffb357; } .activity-heading, .activity-origin, .activity-outcome { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px; align-items: baseline; min-width: 0; } .activity-heading { justify-content: space-between; } .activity-heading strong { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .activity-count { font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .activity-origin { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; opacity: .8; } .activity-outcome { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; } .activity-review { color: #ffb357; } .activity-open { margin-left: auto; color: #5794f2; } .activity-empty { padding: 16px; }

panels.title: CrowdSec alert records
panels.description: Structured native alerts, filtered by the selected site and source. The main list presents these same detections; engine diagnostic logs are separate.

targets.expr: {security="crowdsec"} | json sites, source_ip, scenario, stop_at, events_count | sites=~`.*"(${site:regex})".*` | source_ip=~`${source:regex}.*` | __error__="" | line_format `{{.stop_at}} | {{.source_ip}} | {{.scenario}} | {{.events_count}} contributing events | {{.sites}}`

panels.title: Detection health
panels.description: Server-wide collector health, independent of site/source filters. Zero means scrape failure; a missing series is unknown. Heartbeat and parser stall alerts cover services that are running but not processing logs.

panels.title: Response latency / p95
panels.description: Approximate histogram p95 for selected sites. Source-IP filter does not apply to aggregate metrics.

panels.title: Response bandwidth
panels.description: Response-body bytes for selected sites. Source-IP filter does not apply to aggregate metrics.

panels.title: Scenario detections
panels.description: Server-wide detections per five-minute window. These are detections, not bans; no source/site filter applies.

panels.title: Firewall evidence
panels.description: Existing UFW kernel journal records from the last five minutes only. Unknown can mean quiet traffic, disabled logging or unavailable journal access. No logging rules are installed. Firewall and journal rate limits can omit packets.

panels.title: Published bindings
panels.description: Docker bindings on non-loopback addresses, including private and wildcard addresses. IPv4 and IPv6 bindings count separately. This does not establish Internet reachability or firewall policy.

targets.expr: (count(prodenv_health_container_published_port{job="node",binding="non_loopback"}) or vector(0)) and on() (max(prodenv_health_collector_success{collector="system"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(prodenv_health_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job="node"}) < 600) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Firewall sample
panels.description: The collector reads at most 5,001 recent matching records and processes at most 5,000. Within limit does not imply all network packets were logged.

targets.expr: max(prodenv_health_firewall_sample_truncated{job="node"}) and on() (max(prodenv_health_firewall_observation_available{job="node"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(prodenv_health_last_run_timestamp_seconds{job="node"}) < 600) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Logged firewall drops / 5m
panels.description: Overlapping five-minute samples of existing UFW BLOCK/REJECT records, not packet totals. Configured destination ports have individual series; all others are grouped as other. Gaps mean no evidence, not zero drops.

panels.title: Docker published bindings
panels.description: Actual Docker bindings, including loopback. Network firewall/NAT policy and external reachability are not inferred.

panels.title: Host listeners
panels.description: Host TCP/UDP listeners from ss. Docker NAT bindings may not appear as sockets; inspect both inventories.
